svg.title: How TMB works
svg.desc: How can I trust my bot? Coding agents call broken work done, forget it all, drift off task, need babysitting and delete your data. TMB is a multi-agent harness for Claude Code. You get an idea and hand it to bro. bro checks its memory, the world model of your codebase and the trajectory DB of past work, writes a plan and splits it across two swe agents, who turn it into code. pr-reviewer rejects changes that fail and sends them back to swe, and approves the rest before they are pushed to GitHub, and GitHub emails you. Both memories are updated, so bro picks up where it left off. Trust Me Bro, It Works.
